### BuddhaIq [...] Buddylist IM is a independent Secure messaging platform with user to user calling support, that will keep your privacy safe, encrypted, and allow you to still have fun with all your contacts.   
  
This app is totally independent from the Buddylist Social Network. Works on its own.  
  
you can send messages, photos, videos and files of any type (doc, zip, mp3, etc), as well as create groups for up to 5000 people or channels for broadcasting to unlimited audiences.  
  
You can write to your phone contacts and find people by their usernames.  
  
Most chat apps today are owned by big corporations that sell your private info to make more money. This is a alternative to other chat apps. Anyone on your phone's contact list that has this app will be allowed to send you a friend request.
